about: RBI Draft Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026 (press release 2026-2027/528, June 2026; comments were due 24 July 2026). A DRAFT: proposed expectations, not rules in force. References and links to library controls only; check the final text before relying on it.

ET-001.RBI MRM draft 2026: board-approved framework; model inventory; risk tiering; independent validation

controls.title: Human-in-command: override, suspension and kill switch for AI models
controls.description: A named person can override, suspend or deactivate any AI model, or all AI at once, effective immediately, with the reason recorded and shown to callers.

citations.RBI MRM draft 2026: human oversight; override, suspension and deactivation mechanisms

controls.title: Living model inventory: tier, owner, third-party source, explainability, validation and decommission records
controls.description: Every model in use, internal or third-party, is listed with its risk tier, owner, explainability statement and last independent validation; retired models keep their records for at least 10 years.

citations.RBI MRM draft 2026: model inventory; tiering; third-party accountability; decommissioned-model records

controls.title: Customer-facing AI discloses it is AI and offers a human
controls.description: Customers are told when they interact with AI and can switch to a human on request.
